story.title: Conflicting Court Rulings Create Chaos Over Missouri's Congressional Map
story.summary: A federal judge has ruled that Missouri should proceed with a new congressional map favoring Republicans, following a decision by the U.S. Supreme Court to uphold a state court ruling that directed the use of an older map. This situation has led to confusion and potential impacts on the upcoming midterm elections, as the Missouri Supreme Court has also ordered a contempt hearing regarding the secretary of state's compliance with redistricting orders.

related_stories.title: Trump Gave $45,000 Holiday Gifts to Aides, Financial Disclosures Reveal
related_stories.summary: Donald Trump provided $45,000 holiday gifts to Natalie Harp and two other White House aides, as detailed in recent financial disclosures. This amount was categorized as 'cash gift for the holidays' and was in addition to their regular salaries. The practice of giving such gifts has been described as longstanding by a White House spokesperson.
